problem.title: DiLO KITTI Odom seq 00 full: comparison with the paper's KITTI table
problem.question: How close is the DiLO reimplementation to the paper's per-sequence KITTI Odometry translational error (official RTE)?

variants.label: DiLO, default parameters
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).

variants.label: DiLO, dense profile
variants.intent: Profile used for the repository's KITTI full-sequence runs (see the method README).

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry (plane key points, 10-frame window, pairwise averaging)
variants.intent: Sec. 3 of the paper without edge key points: 192x2048 sin-elevation range image with vertical fill, Farid-filter normals, eleven planarity-weighted key-point lists, eq. 18 residual, Algorithm 1 with N = 10 and 5 update iterations. Compare with DiLO-plane in Table 1.

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry + 0.22 deg beam correction
variants.intent: paper_odometry on scans with the KITTI vertical-angle correction (the paper does not mention it).

variants.label: DiLO paper odometry without the window re-estimation
variants.intent: Only the Huber registration of each new frame to the last 10 frames (Algorithm 1 without the update loop).

variants.label: DiLO paper pipeline + spread planar key points + slope-aware vertical fill + 0.18 deg correction
variants.intent: Planarity > 0.98 and at most one key point per 8 x 8 px cell per list (the ground list clustered ahead of the car, the side lists on vegetation, so roll was barely constrained), a vertical fill that no longer puts the far ground under the road (fill_slope 0.1), and the 0.18 deg correction that zeroes the pitch bias once the fill is fixed. Chosen on 07 windows, 00 windows held out (see papers/dilo/README.md).
